nodes.name: db.py
nodes.summary: SQLite persistence layer: job upsert/evaluation, discovery provenance and provider runs, application lifecycle, user statuses, career fits/documents/evidence/artifacts, and user artifacts — all through a shared connect() wrapper.

nodes.name: _now
nodes.summary: Current UTC timestamp string.

nodes.name: connect
nodes.summary: Opens a SQLite connection with row factory and pragmas.

nodes.name: upsert_job
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates a job by canonical URL, returning its id.

nodes.name: record_evaluation
nodes.summary: Stores a job evaluation (score and stage) for a user.

nodes.name: get_job
nodes.summary: Fetches a job by id.

nodes.name: update_user_job_status
nodes.summary: Updates a user job status record.

nodes.name: get_jobs
nodes.summary: Queries jobs with filters and ordering.

nodes.name: jobs_for_analysis
nodes.summary: Returns jobs pending fit/evaluation analysis.

nodes.name: _job_from_row
nodes.summary: Maps a SQLite row to a Job model.

nodes.name: _parse_dt
nodes.summary: Parses a stored datetime string.

nodes.name: evaluate_and_store
nodes.summary: Scores a job and persists evaluation atomically.

nodes.name: list_matched_jobs
nodes.summary: Lists jobs matching the user with scores.

nodes.name: get_user_status_counts
nodes.summary: Counts jobs per user status bucket.

nodes.name: get_jobs_by_user_status
nodes.summary: Lists jobs filtered by user status.

nodes.name: apply_lifecycle
nodes.summary: Applies lifecycle stage transitions to stored jobs.

nodes.name: active_count
nodes.summary: Counts active jobs.

nodes.name: stats_counts
nodes.summary: Aggregates per-source and per-method stats counts.

nodes.name: best_url
nodes.summary: Picks the best of two job URLs (prefers https, non-canonical).

nodes.name: find_duplicate_of
nodes.summary: Finds an existing duplicate of a job by fingerprint fields.

nodes.name: deduplicate
nodes.summary: De-duplicates stored jobs keeping canonical URLs and logging removed rows.

nodes.name: record_job_source
nodes.summary: Records which source discovered a job.

nodes.name: job_sources_for
nodes.summary: Lists source provenance for a job.

nodes.name: source_job_counts
nodes.summary: Counts jobs contributed per source.

nodes.name: discovery_method_counts
nodes.summary: Counts jobs per discovery method.

nodes.name: canonical_url_stats
nodes.summary: Reports canonical-URL normalization stats.

nodes.name: record_scan_run
nodes.summary: Stores a completed scan run with timing.

nodes.name: average_source_duration_ms
nodes.summary: Average scan duration per source in ms.

nodes.name: record_provider_run
nodes.summary: Stores a provider run result and its run stats.

nodes.name: latest_provider_runs
nodes.summary: Latest provider run stats per source.

nodes.name: latest_provider_run_for_source
nodes.summary: Latest provider run stats for one source.

nodes.name: provider_failure_count
nodes.summary: Counts consecutive provider failures for a source.

nodes.name: record_discovery_run
nodes.summary: Stores a discovery run with aggregates.

nodes.name: latest_discovery_run
nodes.summary: Latest discovery run record.

nodes.name: get_application
nodes.summary: Fetches an application by id.

nodes.name: save_application
nodes.summary: Creates or updates an application in its lifecycle stage.

nodes.name: application_stage_counts
nodes.summary: Counts applications per stage.

nodes.name: list_applications
nodes.summary: Lists applications.

nodes.name: application_job_exists
nodes.summary: Checks whether a job already has an application.

nodes.name: record_decision
nodes.summary: Records an application decision with timestamp.

nodes.name: recent_decisions
nodes.summary: Lists recent decisions.

nodes.name: get_preference
nodes.summary: Reads a named preference.

nodes.name: set_preference
nodes.summary: Writes a named preference.

nodes.name: list_preferences
nodes.summary: Lists all preferences.

nodes.name: save_career_fit
nodes.summary: Persists a career fit assessment for a job.

nodes.name: get_career_fit
nodes.summary: Fetches the stored career fit.

nodes.name: save_career_document
nodes.summary: Stores an ingested career document.

nodes.name: get_career_document
nodes.summary: Fetches a career document by id.

nodes.name: has_career_document
nodes.summary: Checks document existence.

nodes.name: list_career_documents
nodes.summary: Lists career documents.

nodes.name: save_career_evidence
nodes.summary: Stores one evidence entry.

nodes.name: save_career_evidence_many
nodes.summary: Stores multiple evidence entries.

nodes.name: get_career_evidence
nodes.summary: Fetches evidence entries.

nodes.name: career_evidence_count
nodes.summary: Counts evidence entries.

nodes.name: save_career_reconciliation
nodes.summary: Stores a document reconciliation result.

nodes.name: list_career_reconciliations
nodes.summary: Lists reconciliation results.

nodes.name: _next_artifact_version
nodes.summary: Computes the next artifact version string (v1, v2, ...).

nodes.name: _insert_artifact
nodes.summary: Inserts an artifact with next-version handling.

nodes.name: save_career_artifact
nodes.summary: Saves a career artifact, bumping version if not new.

nodes.name: get_career_artifact
nodes.summary: Fetches a career artifact by id/version.

nodes.name: list_career_artifacts
nodes.summary: Lists career artifacts.

nodes.name: artifact_require_approval
nodes.summary: Installs the approval requirement flag for the given artifact type.

nodes.name: _now_iso
nodes.summary: Current ISO timestamp.

nodes.name: save_user_artifact
nodes.summary: Stores an uploaded user artifact + file record.

nodes.name: get_user_artifact
nodes.summary: Fetches a user artifact.

nodes.name: get_user_artifacts_for_job
nodes.summary: Lists user artifacts associated with a job.

nodes.name: update_user_artifact
nodes.summary: Updates artifact metadata and/or body.

nodes.name: delete_user_artifact
nodes.summary: Deletes a user artifact row and file.

nodes.name: approve_user_artifact
nodes.summary: Marks a user artifact approved.

nodes.name: archive_user_artifact
nodes.summary: Marks a user artifact archived.

nodes.name: logging_setup.py
nodes.summary: Logging configuration and helpers: structureless-event logging facade with a timed() ContextDecorator for duration timing, plus get_logger factory.

nodes.name: configure_logging
nodes.summary: Configures the root logger format/level.

nodes.name: get_logger
nodes.summary: Returns a named logger.

nodes.name: log_event
nodes.summary: Emits a JSON-event-style log line via a structured event logger.

nodes.name: _fmt
nodes.summary: Formats an event dict into a log line.

nodes.name: timed
nodes.summary: ContextDecorator measuring elapsed time.

nodes.name: migrations.py
nodes.summary: SQLite schema migrations: 11 versioned __migrate_* steps (initial schema through user artifacts), guarded by creatable-connection checks and a current-version tracker.

nodes.name: _exec_many
nodes.summary: Executes many SQL statements in one connection.

nodes.name: migration
nodes.summary: Migration decorator registering a step and its version.

nodes.name: _v1_initial
nodes.summary: Initial schema: jobs, evaluations, status.

nodes.name: _column_exists
nodes.summary: Checks whether a column exists in a table.

nodes.name: _v2_foundation
nodes.summary: Foundation tables: user status, sources, scan runs, decisions, evaluation history.

nodes.name: _v3_career_fit
nodes.summary: Career fit tables.

nodes.name: _v4_career_documents
nodes.summary: Career documents, evidence, reconciliations.

nodes.name: _v5_artifact_versioning
nodes.summary: Career artifact versioning tables.

nodes.name: _v6_discovery_provenance
nodes.summary: Discovery provenance tables.

nodes.name: _v7_user_job_status
nodes.summary: User job status table.

nodes.name: _v8_provider_runs
nodes.summary: Provider runs tables.

nodes.name: _v9_discovery_runs
nodes.summary: Discovery runs tables.

nodes.name: _v10_application_lifecycle
nodes.summary: Application lifecycle tables.

nodes.name: _v11_user_artifacts
nodes.summary: User artifacts tables.

nodes.name: current_version
nodes.summary: Reads the current schema version from the DB.
